name: Clindacin ETZ
indications_original:
Clindacin
                     ®
                      ETZ is indicated in the treatment of acne vulgaris. In view of the potential for diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis, the physician should consider whether other agents are more appropriate (see 
                        CONTRAINDICATIONS, WARNINGS
                      and 
                        ADVERSE REACTIONS
                     ).
contraindications_original: Do not use if the unit-dose pouch seal is broken. Remove pledget just before use. Use pledget to apply a thin film of Clindamycin Phosphate Topical Solution to the affected area twice daily. More than one pledget may be used. Each pledget should be used only once and then discarded.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Clindacin
                     ®
                      ETZ (Clindamycin Phosphate Topical Solution USP, 1% (Pledgets)) is available as follows:
                  A carton containing 60 individually wrapped single-use pledget applicators (NDC 43538-172-60)
adverseReactions_original:
Clindacin
                     ®
                      ETZ is contraindicated in individuals with a history of hypersensitivity to preparations containing clindamycin or lincomycin, a history of regional enteritis or ulcerative colitis, or a history of antibiotic-associated colitis.
